properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 31 at 9:41AM CDT until July 31 at 11:15AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
SMWMOB

The National Weather Service in Mobile has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Pensacola FL from 20 to
60 NM...

* Until 1115 AM CDT.

* At 941 AM CDT, a strong thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 9 nm south of Oriskany Reef, or 28 nm
southeast of Pensacola Pass. The strong thunderstorm was nearly
stationary.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
properties.area: Waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Pensacola FL from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 31 at 10:37AM EDT until July 31 at 12:30PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL

* Special Marine Warning for...

just after midnight tonight.

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

through flooded areas.

or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

properties.title: Air Quality Alert issued July 27 at 10:40AM MDT by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
AQAMSO

* WHAT...Air Quality Advisory due to smoke from wildfires.

Air Quality Index ranging from Moderate to Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups.

* WHERE...All Areas on the Nez Perce Reservation.

* WHEN...Until 10:00 AM PDT Friday July 31.

* IMPACTS...Those who experience health effects from smoke include
children under 18, elders, pregnant women, people with asthma
or have difficulty breathing, diabetes, heart problems or
otherwise compromised health, and people who have high exposure
(those who work, exercise, or spend extensive time outdoors).
properties.instruction:
Under the most severe pollution level, sensitive groups should avoid
outdoor exposure and limit indoor activities, and everyone should
restrict their outdoor activities.

Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
https://healthandwelfare.idaho.gov/health-wellness/environmental-
health/wildfire-smoke
Idaho Smoke Information Hotline: 1-800-345-1007
